## ChatCourseLink

Supporting declaration used by a public type. This is not an additional runtime API or SDK helper.

The chat record's back-pointer into a course.

```ts
export type ChatCourseLink = {
    role: "setup";
    courseId?: string;
} | {
    role: "unit";
    courseId: string;
    unitId: string;
} | {
    role: "practice";

};
```
